<function name="KeyReleased" parent="Player" type="classfunc">
	<description>Gets whether a key was just released this tick.</description>
	<realm>Shared</realm>
	<args>
		<arg name="key" type="number">The key, see <page>Enums/IN</page></arg>
	</args>
	<rets>
		<ret name="" type="boolean">Was released or not</ret>
	</rets>
</function>

<example>
	<description>Prints whenever the first player first stops pressing <key>+FORWARD</key> key (<key>W</key> on QWERTY keyboards).</description>
	<code>
hook.Add( "Tick", "CheckPlayer1Forward", function()
	if Entity( 1 ):KeyReleased( IN_FORWARD ) then
		print( "Player1 just stopped moving forward!" )
	end
end )
	</code>
</example>
